scope_guards: Green Belt snapshot records are not parcel permissions, ownership or exact current boundaries.
Annual-return timing is retained; later local-plan boundary changes are not inferred into the snapshot.
Zero-row MOL data is not evidence that Metropolitan Open Land is absent.
Zero-row Local Green Space data is not evidence that no local designation exists.
Green Belt, MOL and Local Green Space remain distinct policy designations and are not merged.
Inappropriate-development policy is proposal-specific and is not an automatic outcome.
Planning-policy geometry is not an HMLR title or development red-line.
No score or promotion is written without current local-plan mapping, exact site relation, planning case and title evidence.
